name: interaction-conversational-fallback
description: The capability gate. A session that did NOT declare `identity_form` in `supports` (a text-only channel — SMS, voice) must NEVER receive `interaction_required`: the same `request_identity_intake` raise degrades to its conversational fallback, returning immediately to the model so the turn runs straight through to its reply with no park. This is the negative half of interaction-park-resume — same mock script, capability removed — and it pins that the gate is read per turn from the session's declared capabilities rather than the kind being unconditionally rich.
